lt001.e: He's asked to take drinks to the room; the copies are done and Yamada already set out the chairs.
lt001.t:
At a company, a man and a woman are talking. What will the man do next?
Woman: Tanaka, did you copy the documents for the meeting?
Man: Yes, I already did.
Woman: Thank you. Then please take some drinks to the meeting room.
Man: Sure. Shall I set out the chairs too?
Woman: Yamada has already set out the chairs.
Man: I see.

lt002.e: She only buys 3 apples; no mandarins today.
lt002.t:
At a shop, a woman and a shop clerk are talking. What will the woman buy?
Woman: Excuse me, how much are these apples?
Man: 100 yen each. These mandarins are 300 yen for five.
Woman: I see. Then three apples, please.
Man: Sure. How about some mandarins?
Woman: No mandarins today, thanks.

lt003.e: The school provides pencils and paper; bring lunch and a drink.
lt003.t:
At school, a teacher and a student are talking. What will the students bring tomorrow?
Man: Everyone, tomorrow we'll draw pictures in the park.
Woman: Teacher, should we bring pencils?
Man: No, the school has pencils and paper. Please bring a packed lunch and something to drink.
Woman: What about umbrellas?
Man: The weather will be nice tomorrow, so you won't need them.

lt004.e: They decide to take the 10:30 express.
lt004.t:
At the station, a man and a woman are talking. What time is the train the two of them will take?
Man: What time is the next train?
Woman: 10:15. Oh, but that's not an express.
Man: And the express?
Woman: 10:30. The express gets there sooner.
Man: Then let's take the express.

lt005.e: Onions are missing, and she also asks for milk.
lt005.t:
At home, a woman and a man are talking. What will the man go to buy?
Woman: I'm making curry tonight. I need meat, carrots and onions.
Man: What's in the fridge?
Woman: There's meat and carrots. There are no onions.
Man: Then I'll go buy some.
Woman: Thanks. Oh, and milk too, please.

lt006.t:
In the classroom, a teacher is talking. Which pages will the students do for homework?
Woman: Here is today's homework. Please look at page 20 of your textbook.
Woman: Do the questions from page 20 to page 23.
Woman: Oh, you don't have to do page 22. We'll do it next week.

lt007.e: First clean the room; then the tea.
lt007.t:
At a company, a woman and a man are talking. What will the man do first?
Woman: Suzuki, a customer is coming at 3.
Man: OK.
Woman: Before that, please clean the meeting room. Then please prepare some tea.
Man: Understood. Shall I call the customer too?
Woman: I'll make the call.

lt008.e: They'll meet at the entrance of the bookstore in the station.
lt008.t:
A man and a woman are talking. Where will the woman wait for the man?
Man: For the movie tomorrow, shall we meet in front of the station?
Woman: It's crowded in front of the station, so how about the bookstore inside the station?
Man: The bookstore? Sure.
Woman: Then I'll wait at the entrance of the bookstore.

lt009.e: He buys the small blue one.
lt009.t:
At a shop, a man and a shop clerk are talking. Which shirt will the man buy?
Man: Excuse me, do you have this shirt in white?
Woman: In white we only have a large one. In blue we have a small one too.
Man: A large one is a bit... Then the small blue one, please.

lt010.t:
At school, a female student and a male student are talking. Where will the male student go next?
Woman: Are you going to the library now?
Man: No, first I'm going to eat lunch in the cafeteria. Then I'll go to the library.
Woman: I'll come to the cafeteria with you.

lt011.e: He says he'll be there by 5:30.
lt011.t:
A man and a woman are talking on the phone. By what time will the man go to the woman's house?
Woman: Hello. Tomorrow's party starts at 6.
Man: OK. Can I help with anything?
Woman: Thank you. Then please help with the cooking. Can you come around 5?
Man: 5 is a little difficult... I'll be there by 5:30.
Woman: OK, thanks.

lt012.t:
At a hospital, a doctor and a man are talking. When will the man take the medicine?
Woman: Please take this medicine in the morning and at night.
Man: Before meals?
Woman: No, after you eat. You don't need to take it at lunchtime.

lt013.t:
At home, a mother and her child are talking. What will the child do next?
Woman: Yuta, have you finished your homework yet?
Man: Not yet. I want to watch TV now.
Woman: No. Do your homework first, and then watch TV.
Man: Oka-ay.

lt014.e: Computer and microphone; the projector is already there.
lt014.t:
At a company, a man and a woman are talking. What will the woman take?
Man: Yamamoto, please take the computer to the meeting room this afternoon.
Woman: OK. The projector too?
Man: The projector is in the meeting room. Oh, and the microphone too, please.
Woman: Understood.

lt015.e: They decide to study at the girl's house.
lt015.t:
A male student and a female student are talking. Where will the two of them study?
Man: Do you want to study for the test together?
Woman: Sounds good. How about the library?
Man: You can't talk in the library, so how about a café?
Woman: Cafés are expensive, so why don't you come to my house?
Man: OK, let's do that.

lt016.e: She chooses number 3, which is faster.
lt016.t:
At the station, a woman is talking with a station worker. Which bus number will the woman take?
Woman: Excuse me, I'd like to go to Sakura Hospital.
Man: Sakura Hospital... That's bus number 3 or 5.
Woman: Which one is faster?
Man: Number 5 stops at a lot of places, so number 3 is faster.
Woman: I see. Thank you.

lt017.e: She orders a sandwich and a salad.
lt017.t:
At a restaurant, a man and a woman are talking. What will the woman eat?
Man: What will you have? I'll have the hamburger steak.
Woman: I'd like the hamburger steak too, but it's a bit much.
Man: Then how about a sandwich?
Woman: Yes. I'll have a sandwich and a salad.

lt018.e: The meeting moved to 10, so he comes at 9:30.
lt018.t:
At a company, a woman and a man are talking. What time will the man come to the office tomorrow?
Woman: There's a meeting at 9 tomorrow. Please come at 8:30.
Man: 8:30? Understood.
Woman: Oh, sorry. The meeting has been changed to 10. So 9:30 is fine.
Man: Understood.

lt019.e: She wants the photo of everyone at the beach.
lt019.t:
A man and a woman are talking. Which photo will the man send?
Woman: Could you send me the photos from the trip?
Man: Sure. The ones of the mountains?
Woman: The mountain ones are nice too, but I want the one we all took together at the beach.
Man: OK. I'll send that one.

lt020.e: He decides to write 3 sheets (the maximum allowed).
lt020.t:
At school, a teacher and a student are talking. How many sheets will the student write for the composition?
Man: Teacher, how many sheets should the composition be?
Woman: Two. But you can write three.
Man: Is four not OK?
Woman: Four is too many. Please keep it to three at most.
Man: Then I'll write three.

lt021.e: She brings in the laundry; he closes the windows.
lt021.t:
At home, a man and a woman are talking. What will the woman do next?
Man: Oh, it's started raining.
Woman: Oh no, the laundry is outside.
Man: Shall I bring it in?
Woman: No, I'll do it. Please close the windows.
Man: OK.

lt022.t:
A man and a woman are talking. How will the man get to the station?
Woman: Are you going to the station by bus?
Man: No, the bus takes forever to come.
Woman: Then by taxi?
Man: Taxis are expensive, so I'll go by bicycle.

lt023.t:
At a company, a woman and a man are talking. Where will the man put his bag?
Woman: Please put your bag on that chair.
Man: OK. Oh, this chair is Tanaka's, isn't it?
Woman: That's right. Then please put it under the desk.
Man: Understood.

lt024.t:
At a shop, a woman and a shop clerk are talking. How much will the woman pay?
Woman: Two of these cakes, please.
Man: Sure, they're 300 yen each, so that's 600 yen.
Woman: Oh, and one coffee too, please.
Man: Coffee is 200 yen. That's 800 yen in total.

lt025.e: She's dropping Friday: Monday and Wednesday.
lt025.t:
At school, a male student and a female student are talking. On which days will the female student work from next month?
Man: What days do you work at your part-time job?
Woman: Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays.
Man: That's tough.
Woman: Yes. So from next month I'm stopping Fridays.

lt026.t:
A man and a woman are talking. What will the woman bring?
Man: For the picnic tomorrow, I'll make sandwiches.
Woman: Then I'll bring fruit.
Man: Kimura is bringing drinks, so we don't need any.
Woman: OK. Then I'll bring some sweets too.

lt027.t:
At a company, a man and a woman are talking. When will the woman go to Osaka?
Man: Your business trip to Osaka is next Tuesday, right?
Woman: No, it's been changed to Wednesday.
Man: I see. Until when?
Woman: I'll come back Thursday night.

lt028.e: There are 4 people and 2 glasses: he buys 2.
lt028.t:
At home, a woman and a man are talking. What will the man buy?
Woman: Three friends are coming tomorrow. We don't have enough glasses.
Man: How many do we have?
Woman: Only two. With me and my friends, that's four people...
Man: Then I'll go buy two.

lt029.t:
A man and a woman are talking. What time will the two of them meet?
Man: What time shall we meet on Saturday? How about 11?
Woman: 11 is a little difficult... Is 12 OK?
Man: 12? Then let's have lunch together.
Woman: Sounds good.

lt030.t:
In the classroom, a teacher is talking. What will the students put on their desks during the test?
Man: We'll start the test. Please put only a pencil and an eraser on your desk.
Man: Put your bags and books under your chair.
Man: You may also put your watch on your desk.

lt031.t:
A man and a woman are talking. Where will the man go first?
Woman: Are you going to the post office now?
Man: Yes. But before that, I'll take out some money at the bank.
Woman: The bank is only open until 3.
Man: Yes, I'll hurry.

lt032.e: The red one, light and folding.
lt032.t:
At a shop, a man and a shop clerk are talking. Which umbrella will the man buy?
Man: I'd like an umbrella.
Woman: How about this black one? It's big and sturdy.
Man: It's a bit heavy. Do you have a light one?
Woman: This red one is light. It folds up small.
Man: Then I'll take that one.

lt033.e: He'll hand it in on Thursday.
lt033.t:
At school, a male student and a teacher are talking. When will the student hand in his report?
Man: Teacher, when is the report due?
Woman: By Friday.
Man: Sorry, on Friday I have my part-time job and can't come to school.
Woman: Then please hand it in on Thursday.
Man: Understood.

lt034.e: She'll take a taxi because of her luggage.
lt034.t:
A man and a woman are talking. How will the woman get to the hotel?
Man: Can we walk to the hotel?
Woman: It takes about 30 minutes on foot.
Man: Then the bus, I guess.
Woman: I have a lot of luggage, so I'll take a taxi.

lt035.t:
At a company, a woman and a man are talking. How many copies will the man make?
Woman: Please copy these documents. Eight people are coming to the meeting.
Man: Eight copies, then.
Woman: Oh, I don't need one. I already have it.
Man: Then seven.

lt036.t:
A woman and a man are talking. Which train will the man take?
Woman: The train to Tokyo Station leaves from platform 2.
Man: Platform 2. What time?
Woman: 9:10 and 9:40.
Man: The meeting starts at 10, so I'll take the 9:10 one.

lt037.t:
At home, a man and a woman are talking. Where will the woman put the flowers?
Man: Where shall I put these flowers?
Woman: How about next to the TV?
Man: It's dark next to the TV, so by the window would be better.
Woman: You're right. Then I'll put them by the window.

lt038.e: At 9 at the east exit of the station.
lt038.t:
At school, a teacher is talking. What time and where will the students meet tomorrow?
Woman: Tomorrow we're going to the art museum. Please don't come to school.
Woman: Please meet at the east exit of the station at 9.
Woman: Don't be late, OK?

lt039.t:
A man and a woman are talking. What will the man drink?
Woman: Would you like something to drink? There's coffee and tea.
Man: Thank you. I drank coffee last night and couldn't sleep well.
Woman: Then would you like tea?
Man: Tea is also a bit... Water, please.

lt040.t:
At a company, a woman and a man are talking. Who will the man call?
Woman: Kimura, Yamada called a little while ago.
Man: Oh, really?
Woman: He says he wants to know the time of tomorrow's meeting. Please call him.
Man: OK. I'll call right away.

lt041.e: She's going to the library to get a dictionary.
lt041.t:
A male student and a female student are talking. What will the female student do next?
Man: Can you read this kanji?
Woman: No, I don't know it. Let's look it up in a dictionary.
Man: Do you have a dictionary?
Woman: I don't. I'll go borrow one from the library.

lt042.t:
At a shop, a woman and a shop clerk are talking. What will the woman buy?
Woman: Excuse me, a notebook and pencils, please.
Man: Sure. One notebook, and how many pencils?
Woman: Two notebooks and one pencil, please.

lt043.t:
At home, a woman and a man are talking. What time will the man get up?
Woman: What time are you getting up tomorrow?
Man: My flight is at 10, so I'll get up at 6.
Woman: It takes two hours to get to the airport. Will you leave home at 7?
Man: Then I'll get up at 5:30.

lt044.e: The small room on the 1st floor.
lt044.t:
A man and a woman are talking. In which room will the two of them talk?
Man: Shall we talk in the meeting room on the 3rd floor?
Woman: The meeting room on the 3rd floor is being used right now.
Man: Then how about the 2nd floor?
Woman: The 2nd floor is also... The small room on the 1st floor is free.
Man: Then let's go there.

lt045.t:
At school, a teacher and a student are talking. What will the students bring next week?
Man: Next week we're going to cook.
Woman: Teacher, what do we need?
Man: Please bring an apron. We'll buy the meat and vegetables at school.
Woman: What about chopsticks?
Man: There are chopsticks at school too.

lt046.e: A sweater and skirt because of the cold.
lt046.t:
A man and a woman are talking. What clothes will the woman wear?
Woman: For the party tomorrow, how about this dress?
Man: It's nice. But it's going to be cold tomorrow.
Woman: Really? Then I'll wear a sweater and a skirt.
Man: That's a good idea.

lt047.t:
At a company, a man and a woman are talking. What will the woman do first?
Man: Nakamura, please read this email and write a reply.
Woman: OK. I'm calling a customer right now, so is it OK if I do it after that?
Man: Yes, that's fine.

lt048.e: Because of the construction, the west exit.
lt048.t:
At the station, a man and a woman are talking. Which exit will the man leave from?
Man: Excuse me, I'd like to go to Midori Park.
Woman: Midori Park is at the north exit.
Man: The north exit, OK.
Woman: Oh, the north exit is under construction now, so please go out through the west exit.

lt049.e: It's closed on Tuesday; he'll go on Wednesday.
lt049.t:
A man and a woman are talking. On which day will the man go to the hospital?
Woman: Did you go to the hospital?
Man: No, not yet. I'll go tomorrow, Tuesday.
Woman: The hospital is closed on Tuesdays.
Man: Really? Then I'll go on Wednesday.

lt050.t:
At home, a mother and a boy are talking. What will the boy wear to go out?
Woman: It's cold outside. Wear your coat.
Man: The coat is heavy, so I don't want to.
Woman: Then wear a sweater.
Man: OK.

lt051.e: He'll come the day after tomorrow.
lt051.t:
At a shop, a man and a shop clerk are talking. When will the man come to pick up the watch?
Man: Can this watch be fixed?
Woman: Yes. We'll fix it by tomorrow evening.
Man: I can't come tomorrow. Is the day after tomorrow OK?
Woman: Yes, that's fine.

lt052.t:
A male student and a female student are talking. What will the male student lend?
Woman: I forgot my notebook for tomorrow's class.
Man: Shall I lend you mine?
Woman: I already borrowed a notebook from a friend. But I don't have a dictionary.
Man: I have a dictionary. I'll lend it to you.

lt053.t:
At a company, a woman and a man are talking. What will the man prepare?
Woman: For next week's meeting, please prepare boxed lunches.
Man: For how many people?
Woman: For ten. There are drinks at the office, so we don't need any.
Man: Understood. Ten boxed lunches, then.

lt054.t:
A man and a woman are talking. How will the woman travel?
Man: You're going to Hokkaido for the summer holidays, right? By plane?
Woman: Planes are expensive, so I'd like to go by train...
Man: The train takes a long time.
Woman: That's true. Then I'll go by plane after all.

lt055.t:
At school, a teacher is talking. Which page will the students read?
Man: Please open your textbooks to page 45.
Man: Today we'll read page 46. Page 45 is homework.

lt056.e: He'll go to the ticket gate and wait for her there.
lt056.t:
A man and a woman are talking on the phone. Where will the woman wait for the man?
Woman: Hello, I've just arrived at the station.
Man: I'm at the café in front of the station right now.
Woman: Where's the café? I can't find it.
Man: Then I'll come to the station ticket gate. Please wait there.

lt057.t:
At home, a man and a woman are talking. Where will the man call?
Woman: The TV isn't showing anything.
Man: You're right. Shall I call the shop?
Woman: The shop where we bought it isn't there anymore. Please call the company.
Man: OK. The TV company, right?

lt058.t:
At a shop, a woman and a shop clerk are talking. How many will the woman buy?
Woman: This bread looks delicious. How much is it?
Man: 150 yen each. If you buy three, it's 400 yen.
Woman: Then three, please.

lt059.e: With help, she'll be able to leave at 6:30.
lt059.t:
At a company, a man and a woman are talking. What time will the woman leave the office?
Man: What time are you going home today?
Woman: I want to go home at 6, but I have a lot of work.
Man: Shall I help you?
Woman: Thank you. Then I'll be able to leave by 6:30.

lt060.e: Add the name and the date.
lt060.t:
At school, a teacher and a student are talking. What will the student write on her composition?
Woman: Teacher, how was my composition?
Man: It was very good. But there's no name on it.
Woman: Oh, sorry.
Man: And please write the date too.

lt061.e: On Sunday, when it will be sunny.
lt061.t:
A woman and a man are talking. When will the man go to the mountains?
Woman: When are you going to the mountains?
Man: I want to go this Saturday.
Woman: It's going to rain on Saturday. It'll be sunny on Sunday.
Man: Then I'll go on Sunday.

lt062.t:
At home, a man and a woman are talking. What will the woman make for dinner?
Man: What are you making tonight?
Woman: How about fish?
Man: We had fish yesterday too.
Woman: Then I'll make meat. With vegetables in it too.

lt063.e: He goes to get the section manager.
lt063.t:
At a company, a woman and a man are talking. Who will the man go and call next?
Woman: Suzuki, the customer has arrived.
Man: OK. In the meeting room?
Woman: Yes. But he says he wants to talk with the section manager first.
Man: Then I'll go call the section manager.

lt064.t:
At a shop, a man and a woman are talking. What will the two of them buy?
Man: What would be good for Yamada's birthday present?
Woman: How about a book?
Man: Yamada doesn't read books much.
Woman: Then how about a handkerchief?
Man: Good idea. Let's do that.

lt065.t:
At school, a male student and a female student are talking. What time will the female student go to the classroom?
Man: What time does tomorrow's class start?
Woman: At 9. But the teacher told us to come a little early.
Man: About how many minutes?
Woman: Fifteen.

lt066.e: He'll go to the white building.
lt066.t:
A woman and a man are talking. What will the man do?
Woman: Excuse me, please don't smoke here.
Man: Oh, sorry. Where can I smoke?
Woman: Outside, in front of that white building.
Man: I see. Then I'll go over there.

lt067.e: First she gets off at Midori (the 3rd stop) to change trains.
lt067.t:
At the station, a man and a woman are talking. Where will the woman change trains?
Woman: Excuse me, how many stops is it to Sakura Station?
Man: Sakura Station is the fourth stop. But the express doesn't stop there.
Woman: I see. Then on the express...?
Man: Get off at the third stop, Midori Station, and change trains.

lt068.t:
At home, a woman and a man are talking. What will the man do?
Woman: We have guests coming, so let's clean up the room.
Man: Then I'll vacuum.
Woman: I've already vacuumed. Please wipe the table.
Man: OK.

lt069.t:
A man and a woman are talking. What will the woman learn?
Man: Are you going to start learning something next month?
Woman: I'd like to learn the piano, but it's expensive.
Man: How about the guitar? It's cheap.
Woman: The guitar would be nice too. But I really want to learn singing.

lt070.e: To Tanaka's office on the 3rd floor.
lt070.t:
At a company, a man and a woman are talking. Where will the woman take the computer?
Man: Please take this computer to the 3rd floor.
Woman: To the meeting room on the 3rd floor?
Man: No, to Tanaka's room on the 3rd floor.
Woman: Understood.

lt071.e: First give the documents to the manager.
lt071.t:
At a company, a woman and a man are talking. What will the man do first?
Woman: Hayashi, could you go and mail this letter?
Man: Sure. At the post office, right?
Woman: Yes. But before that, please give these documents to the department manager.
Man: Understood.

lt072.t:
At a shop, a man and a shop clerk are talking. Which cake will the man buy?
Man: Excuse me, do you have strawberry cake?
Woman: Sorry, the strawberry ones are sold out. We have chocolate and cheese.
Man: Then two cheese ones, please.

lt073.t:
At school, a teacher is talking to the students. What time will the students come to school tomorrow?
Man: Tomorrow we're going to see a movie.
Man: The movie starts at 10, so please come to school at 9.
Man: Oh, the bus time has been moved earlier, so please come at 8:30.

lt074.t:
At home, a woman and a man are talking. What will the man take with him?
Woman: It's going to rain from the afternoon today. Take an umbrella.
Man: OK. Also, is it cold today?
Woman: No, it's warm, so you don't need a coat.
Man: Got it.

lt075.t:
At the station, a woman and a man are talking. Where will the woman change trains?
Woman: I'd like to go to Minato Station.
Man: Take this train to Sakura Station. Change to the blue train there.
Woman: Sakura Station. Thank you very much.

lt076.e: The room with a mountain view.
lt076.t:
A man and a woman are talking. Which room will the woman book?
Man: Which hotel room shall we get?
Woman: A room with a view of the sea would be nice.
Man: The sea-view rooms are expensive. 20,000 yen a night.
Woman: Really? Then I'll take a room with a view of the mountains. That's 12,000 yen, right?

lt077.t:
At a company, a man and a woman are talking. What time will the woman call the customer?
Man: Kimura, please call the customer.
Woman: Now?
Man: The customer is in a meeting now. It ends at 3, so please call after that.
Woman: Then I'll call around 3:30.

lt078.t:
At home, a mother and a boy are talking. Where will the boy put his shoes?
Woman: Don't leave your shoes in the entrance, OK?
Man: Then where should I put them?
Woman: Put them in the shoe cupboard on the right side of the entrance.
Man: Oka-ay.

lt079.t:
At school, a female student and a male student are talking. What will the male student go to buy?
Woman: Can you help me get ready for the party?
Man: Sure. What should I do?
Woman: Please go buy drinks and paper cups. I already bought the snacks.
Man: Got it.

lt080.e: He goes to the taxi stand.
lt080.t:
A man and a woman are talking on the phone. Where will the man go?
Man: Hello, I've just arrived at the station.
Woman: Please take a bus from the station to my house.
Man: Which bus number?
Woman: Number 5. But there aren't many buses, so a taxi might be better.
Man: Then I'll go to the taxi stand.

lt081.t:
At a company, a woman and a man are talking. How many chairs will the man bring from the next room?
Woman: There will be twelve people at the meeting. Please set out the chairs.
Man: There are eight chairs now, right?
Woman: Then please bring some from the next room.
Man: Four, then. Understood.

lt082.t:
At a shop, a woman and a shop clerk are talking. What will the woman buy?
Woman: Do you have this shirt in M?
Man: In M we only have white.
Woman: White isn't really... How about black in L?
Man: We have black in L.
Woman: Then I'll take that, please.

lt083.e: Cleaning in the morning and shopping in the afternoon.
lt083.t:
A man and a woman are talking. What will the man do tomorrow?
Woman: Tomorrow is Sunday. Are you going anywhere?
Man: I want to go shopping, but my room is dirty.
Woman: Then it's cleaning time.
Man: Yes, I'll clean in the morning and go shopping in the afternoon.

lt084.t:
At a hospital, a receptionist and a man are talking. What will the man do first?
Woman: Is this your first visit?
Man: Yes, it's my first time.
Woman: Then please write your name and address on this form. After that, please show me your health insurance card.
Man: OK.

lt085.t:
A woman and a man are talking. How will the woman get to the airport?
Man: Shall I drive you to the airport?
Woman: Thanks. But the roads are crowded in the morning.
Man: Then the train, I guess.
Woman: No, I'll take the airport bus. I can get on in front of my house.

lt086.e: In the box in front of the office.
lt086.t:
At school, a teacher is talking. Where will the students hand in their compositions?
Woman: Please hand in your compositions by tomorrow.
Woman: Don't put them on my desk; put them in the box in front of the office.

lt087.t:
At home, a man and a woman are talking. What time will the man leave home?
Woman: What time is tomorrow's game?
Man: At 10. It takes an hour to get to the field.
Woman: Then will you leave at 9?
Man: No, we practice before the game, so I'll leave at 8.

lt088.t:
At a company, a man and a woman are talking. Which pages of the documents will the woman copy?
Man: Please copy these documents before the meeting.
Woman: All of them?
Man: No, we don't need pages 1 and 2. Pages 3 to 5, please.
Woman: Understood.

lt089.t:
A woman and a man are talking. What will the man eat?
Woman: What shall we have for lunch? How about soba?
Man: I had soba yesterday.
Woman: Then what about curry?
Man: Curry is a bit spicy... I'll have sushi.

lt090.t:
At a shop, a man and a shop clerk are talking. How much will the man pay?
Man: This book and this notebook, please.
Woman: The book is 1,500 yen and the notebook is 200 yen.
Man: Oh, make it two notebooks, please.
Woman: Then that's 1,900 yen in total.

lt091.t:
At school, a male student and a female student are talking. When will the female student go to the library?
Man: Do you want to go to the library today?
Woman: I have my part-time job today.
Man: Then how about tomorrow?
Woman: Tomorrow afternoon is fine.

lt092.e: In front of the reception on the 1st floor.
lt092.t:
At a company, a woman and a man are talking. Where will the man wait?
Woman: When the customer arrives, please wait in the meeting room on the 2nd floor.
Man: They're cleaning the 2nd floor right now.
Woman: Really? Then please wait in front of the reception on the 1st floor.
Man: Understood.

lt093.t:
A man and a woman are talking. What will the woman give as a present?
Man: What are you going to give your mother for her birthday?
Woman: I'd like to give her flowers, but I gave her flowers last year too.
Man: How about a bag?
Woman: Bags are expensive, so I'll give her a handkerchief.

lt094.t:
At home, a woman and a man are talking. What will the man do first?
Woman: I'm making dinner, so please help me.
Man: OK. Shall I cut the vegetables?
Woman: Before that, please wash the rice.
Man: Got it.

lt095.t:
At the station, a man and a station worker are talking. What time is the train the man will take?
Man: What time is the train for Osaka?
Woman: The next one is at 11:05. After that, 11:35.
Man: It's 11 now, right? I have to buy a ticket, so... I'll take the :35 one.

lt096.t:
At school, a teacher and a student are talking. What will the students bring tomorrow?
Woman: Tomorrow we'll play sports in the gym.
Man: Teacher, do we need shoes?
Woman: Yes, please bring indoor gym shoes. And a towel too.
Man: What about drinks?
Woman: The school will provide drinks.

lt097.e: The shop on the 1st floor of the company building.
lt097.t:
A woman and a man are talking. Where will the man drink coffee?
Woman: Do you want to go for coffee? How about the place in front of the station?
Man: That place is always crowded.
Woman: Then how about the shop on the 1st floor of our office?
Man: Good idea. Let's go there.

lt098.t:
At a company, a man and a woman are talking. By when will the woman hand in the report?
Man: Please hand in the report by Friday.
Woman: I've taken Friday off.
Man: I see. Then by Thursday evening, please.
Woman: Understood.

lt099.t:
A man and a woman are talking. Where will the two of them meet?
Man: Let's meet in front of the cinema tomorrow.
Woman: It's hot in front of the cinema. Why don't we meet inside?
Man: Then how about the café inside the cinema?
Woman: Sounds good.

lt100.t:
At a shop, a woman and a shop clerk are talking. How many will the woman buy?
Woman: How much are these rice balls (onigiri)?
Man: 120 yen each.
Woman: Then three, please. Oh, please make one of them salmon.
Man: Sure, three in total.

lt101.t:
At home, a man and a woman are talking. What will the woman do next?
Man: Are you going to take a bath?
Woman: I'll do my homework first.
Man: You can do your homework later. The water will get cold.
Woman: Then I'll take a bath first.

lt102.t:
At a company, a woman and a man are talking. What will the man serve the customer?
Woman: The customer has arrived, so please serve something to drink.
Man: Is coffee OK?
Woman: Apparently the customer can't drink coffee. Please serve tea.
Man: Understood.

lt103.t:
At school, a female student and a male student are talking. Which pages will the male student study?
Woman: From which page is the test?
Man: From page 30 to page 50.
Woman: The grammar on page 40 won't be on the test.
Man: Really? Then I'll study everything except that.

lt104.e: Pack the kitchen things into boxes.
lt104.t:
A man and a woman are talking. What will the woman help with?
Man: Could you help me move?
Woman: Sure. Shall I carry the boxes?
Man: My friends will carry the things. Please put the kitchen things into boxes.
Woman: Got it.

lt105.e: Because of the elevator, the south exit.
lt105.t:
At the station, a woman and a man are talking. Which exit will the woman leave from?
Woman: I'd like to go to city hall. Which exit is it?
Man: City hall is at the east exit.
Woman: The east exit, OK.
Man: Oh, if you want to use the elevator, please go out through the south exit. The east exit only has stairs.
Woman: My bags are heavy, so I'll take the south exit.

lt106.t:
At a company, a man and a woman are talking. What does the woman have to do?
Man: Yamada, are you ready for tomorrow's business trip?
Woman: I've bought the shinkansen ticket.
Man: And the hotel?
Woman: Not yet. I'll book it today.

lt107.t:
At home, a woman and a man are talking. Where will the man call?
Woman: My stomach hurts.
Man: Let's go to the hospital. Shall I call the hospital?
Woman: Today is Sunday, so the hospital is closed.
Man: Then I'll ask city hall which hospitals are open on Sundays too.

lt108.t:
At school, a teacher is talking. By what time do the students have to come back to the classroom?
Man: We'll take a 30-minute break now. It's 2 o'clock now.
Man: Please come back to the classroom by 2:30.
Man: Oh, another class is using this classroom from 2:30, so by 2:25, please.

lt109.t:
A man and a woman are talking. What will the man learn?
Woman: I'd like to start something new.
Man: I want to learn cooking.
Woman: You can cook at home.
Man: That's true. Then I'll learn swimming. I can't swim.

lt110.t:
At a shop, a man and a woman are talking. Which one will the two of them buy?
Man: Which table shall we get?
Woman: This round one is cute.
Man: But it's small. Four of us will use it.
Woman: Then let's get this big square one.

lt111.t:
At a company, a woman and a man are talking. Who will the man give the documents to?
Woman: Please give these documents to the section manager.
Man: The section manager is away on a business trip today.
Woman: Really? Then please give them to Suzuki.
Man: Understood.

lt112.t:
At home, a boy and his father are talking. By what time will the boy come home?
Boy: Dad, I'm going over to my friend's house to play.
Father: What time will you be back?
Boy: Around 6.
Father: Dinner is at 6, so come back by 5:30.
Boy: OK.

lt113.t:
A man and a woman are talking. What will the woman take?
Man: For tomorrow's hike, shall we bring lunch?
Woman: There's a restaurant at the top of the mountain, so we don't need it.
Man: What about water?
Woman: Let's bring water. And hats too.

lt114.t:
At school, a male student and a teacher are talking. When will the student go to the teacher's office?
Man: Teacher, I have a question. Is now OK?
Woman: I have a class now... Please come to my office at 4.
Man: I have my part-time job at 4.
Woman: Then how about 12 tomorrow?
Man: Yes, that's fine.

lt115.t:
At a shop, a woman and a shop clerk are talking. Which flowers will the woman buy?
Woman: I'd like to buy flowers for a friend's birthday.
Man: How about these roses?
Woman: Roses are expensive.
Man: Then how about these tulips? We have red and yellow.
Woman: The yellow ones, please.

lt116.t:
At a company, a man and a woman are talking. What will the woman take to the meeting room?
Man: Please take pens and paper to the meeting room.
Woman: OK. The computer too?
Man: I'll take the computer.
Woman: Understood.

lt117.t:
At home, a woman and a man are talking. What will the man buy?
Woman: We're out of bread.
Man: For tomorrow's breakfast? I'll go buy some.
Woman: Thanks. Eggs too, please. We still have milk.
Man: Got it.

lt118.t:
A man and a woman are talking. What time will the woman get up?
Man: You have an early start tomorrow, right? What time will you get up?
Woman: I'm taking the 6 o'clock bus, so I'll get up at 5.
Man: Is the bus stop far?
Woman: It's a 5-minute walk. Then 5:30 should be fine.

lt119.t:
At school, a teacher is talking to the students. What will the students clean today?
Woman: Let's clean the classroom today.
Woman: Oh, another class cleaned the classroom yesterday.
Woman: Then the hallway and the restrooms, please.

lt120.e: First turn it off and on again.
lt120.t:
At a company, a woman and a man are talking. What will the woman do first?
Woman: My computer isn't working.
Man: Is the power on?
Woman: Yes.
Man: Then try turning it off once and turning it on again. If that doesn't work, I'll take a look.
Woman: OK, I'll try that.

lt121.t:
A woman and a man are talking. How will the man get to the office?
Woman: It's snowing a lot. Are you going by car?
Man: Driving on snowy days is dangerous.
Woman: Then by bus?
Man: The buses will be late too. I'll take the subway today.

lt122.t:
At a shop, a man and a shop clerk are talking. Which shoes will the man buy?
Man: Do you have these black shoes in 25 cm?
Woman: Sorry, in black we only have 26 cm. In brown we have 25 cm.
Man: 26 cm is too big... Then the brown ones in 25 cm, please.

lt123.t:
At home, a mother and her daughter are talking. What will the girl wear?
Mother: It's cold today. Put on a sweater.
Daughter: I only have the red sweater.
Mother: The red one is fine, isn't it?
Daughter: The red one is too small. Can I wear my sister's blue one?
Mother: Sure.

lt124.t:
At a company, a man and a woman are talking. What will the woman talk about at the meeting?
Man: At tomorrow's meeting, please talk about the new product.
Woman: Understood. Shall I talk about sales too?
Man: I'll talk about sales.
Woman: OK.

lt125.t:
A man and a woman are talking. On what day will the woman play tennis?
Man: Do you want to play tennis together? How about Saturday?
Woman: I work on Saturday. What about Sunday?
Man: It's going to rain on Sunday.
Woman: Then let's do next Saturday. I'm off that day.

lt126.e: The dictionary and a blue pen.
lt126.t:
At school, a female student and a male student are talking. What will the female student borrow?
Woman: I forgot my dictionary. Could you lend me yours?
Man: Sure. Here.
Woman: Thanks. Oh, and do you have a red pen?
Man: I don't have a red pen, but I have a blue one.
Woman: Then that too, please.

lt127.e: Neither a bath nor a shower.
lt127.t:
At a hospital, a doctor and a woman are talking. What must the woman not do?
Man: It's a cold. I'll give you some medicine.
Woman: Can I take a bath?
Man: You have a fever, so please don't today. No shower either.
Woman: Understood.

lt128.e: The meeting room on the 2nd floor.
lt128.t:
At a company, a woman and a man are talking. Where will the man go to get the documents?
Woman: Suzuki, we don't have enough documents.
Man: Where are they?
Woman: In the storeroom on the 3rd floor.
Man: The 3rd floor, OK.
Woman: Oh, we moved them to the meeting room on the 2nd floor yesterday. They're there.
Man: Understood.

lt129.t:
A man and a woman are talking. What will the man drink?
Woman: What will you have to drink? Beer?
Man: I came by car today, so I can't drink alcohol.
Woman: Then juice?
Man: Sweet drinks aren't really... Oolong tea, please.

lt130.e: Answers on the back, hand it in tomorrow.
lt130.t:
At school, a teacher is talking. What will the students do with the homework?
Man: Today's homework is this sheet.
Man: Please write your answers on the back of the sheet.
Man: And hand it in to me tomorrow morning, before class.

lt131.t:
At a shop, a woman and a shop clerk are talking. When will the woman come?
Woman: Can this camera be repaired?
Man: Yes. It will take a week.
Woman: A week? I can't come next Monday...
Man: Then Tuesday is fine too.
Woman: Then I'll come on Tuesday.

lt132.t:
At a company, a man and a woman are talking. What will the woman do next?
Man: Nakamura, have you had lunch yet?
Woman: No, not yet. I'll eat after I write this email.
Man: The email can wait. Go and eat first.
Woman: Thank you. Then I'll do that.

lt133.e: Number 1, which is coming right away.
lt133.t:
A woman and a man are talking. Which bus will the man take?
Woman: The buses to Midori Park are number 1 and number 3.
Man: Which one is faster?
Woman: Number 1 takes a long time. Number 3 is faster.
Man: But the next number 3 is in 30 minutes. Number 1 is coming right away, so I'll take number 1.

lt134.t:
At home, a man and a woman are talking. Where will the woman hang the photo?
Man: Where will you hang this photo?
Woman: How about above the TV?
Man: There's a clock above the TV.
Woman: Then I'll hang it next to the door.

lt135.t:
At school, a male student and a female student are talking. When will the male student go back to his country?
Woman: Are you going back to your country for the summer holidays?
Man: Yes. I was going to go back at the end of July, but I have my part-time job, so I'll go back on August 10th.
Woman: I see.

lt136.t:
At a company, a woman and a man are talking. How many stamps will the man buy?
Woman: Please mail these letters. Could you go buy some stamps?
Man: How many?
Woman: There are five letters. We have one stamp, so...
Man: Four, then.

lt137.t:
A man and a woman are talking. What will the woman make the cake with?
Man: Are you making a cake? A strawberry cake?
Woman: Strawberries are expensive, so I'll make it with apples.
Man: Sounds good.

lt138.t:
At a hospital, a receptionist and a woman are talking. What time will the woman come back to the hospital?
Man: There are a lot of people today, so you'll wait about an hour.
Woman: An hour? It's 10 now.
Man: Yes. You can go home and come back at 11.
Woman: Then I'll come at 11.

lt139.t:
At a company, a man and a woman are talking. What will the man prepare?
Woman: Tomorrow's customer is from abroad.
Man: Shall I prepare documents in English?
Woman: Japanese documents are fine. He's good at Japanese. Please prepare a gift.
Man: Understood.

lt140.t:
At home, a woman and a man are talking. What time will the man eat dinner?
Woman: What time shall we have dinner? At 7?
Man: I'm going to the gym today, so I'll be late.
Woman: What time will you be back?
Man: Around 8:30. I'll eat at 9.
